observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 164.» (L24) in the left margin.

body L40, L41, notes_left L2, notes_right L2: «dig.» (digiti) is printed small and raised after the number; in the notes its letters are printed broken (the g like an s), and in Plato's two values its full stop did not print.
body L40: the m of «nempe» is printed broken, like ın.
body L18: a short stroke stands before «Tunc»; it is not a sign.
body L42: a speck stands over the m of «productum»; it is not a sign.
notes_left L2, notes_right L2: the 2 of «(2)» and the closing parenthesis of «(4)» are printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
